title: Orders, fulfillment and price snapshot
problem_statement: Customers must be able to track only their own order through a state machine with a frozen price snapshot, and admins must advance fulfillment with no illegal backward transitions, every change audited.
why_now: Orders are the post-payment customer experience and the admin's daily work; they depend on checkout.
hypothesis: An append-only audited state machine plus an order-time price/name/address snapshot gives trustworthy tracking that never drifts with catalog edits.

tier_signals.signal: customer PII shown with own-data-only isolation
tier_signals.evidence_quote: A customer sees only their own data - never another customer's orders or addresses
